question.text: You are the Compliance Officer of 'Vindhya Long-Short Fund' (Cat III open-ended AIF). In one week, the fund has: (a) a foreign investor whose UBO traces to a land-border country; (b) a Cat I FPI seeking AI status for LVF subscription; (c) a breach of the 2x leverage cap on a particular day; (d) a delay in filing FLA return. Which of the following sequences is the CORRECT regulatory response?

answer.text: Ignore the leverage breach if intraday; file FLA annually by 15th July; AI status is automatic for any FPI; UBO screen is optional
Suspend the fund immediately for all four issues and seek SEBI permission before continuing operations
Resign as Compliance Officer to avoid personal liability

(a) Conduct SFA-standard specific DD on the UBO; apply pre-investment DD + post-investment reporting if 10%+ equity triggered; (b) Cat I FPI is a DEEMED Accredited Investor — no separate certificate needed, but document FPI certificate and obtain AI Consent undertaking for LVF; (c) Report leverage breach to Custodian immediately, intimate all investors before 10 AM next working day, square-off excess by EOD next working day, send confirmation; Custodian reports to SEBI before 10 AM next working day; (d) File FLA on FLAIR portal by 15 July; if delayed, file ASAP with explanation and disclose in Compliance Test Report

explanation.text: **The Logic:** This is a synthesis scenario. (a) Oct 2024 SFA Specific-DD Circular for land-border UBOs. (b) Cat I FPI is 'deemed AI' under SEBI AI framework — but LVF requires AI Consent Undertaking per SEBI AI-Framework Circular. (c) Reg 18A + CIR/IMD/DF/10/2013 breach-reporting timelines. (d) FEMA FLA/FLAIR annual filing by 15 July; record non-compliance in Compliance Test Report (Reg 20A framework). **The Trap:** Options A/B/C are all wrong responses — A under-reacts, B over-reacts, C abandons duty (which itself attracts fit-and-proper issues). **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C uniquely tests Compliance-Officer-cross-topic synthesis. III-A/C and XXIV also test ops compliance. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Manager tip: Maintain a Compliance Dashboard with four swim-lanes: (1) Reg-filing calendar (SEBI, FEMA, FATCA/CRS); (2) Event-driven reporting (breach, UPSI trades, side-letters, FLA, FIRMS/InVi); (3) Investor-consent tracker (tenure extension, priority distribution, associate transactions); (4) Specific-DD register (QIB, QB, RBI-regulated, land-border). Weekly review with CIO and Trustee.
